rationale: Project Engineer on roads, drainage and subdivisions with ITPs, lot registers and as-constructed records overlaps Marc's quality and records background.
Requires 'A degree in civil engineering (or equivalent) and 4+ years' experience with a civil contractor' and hands-on ITP and lot conformance experience; Marc has 11 months in the Philippines.
Upper Mount Gravatt Brisbane is interstate; remote-area travel is expected.
caution: 4+ years is stated as required, and the advert also wants a Queensland licence and 'unrestricted rights to work in Australia'.
gaps: No ITP or lot register experience on Australian civil work
Remote-area work is only partly covered by recorded FIFO availability
mandatory_unmet: "A degree in civil engineering (or equivalent) and 4+ years' experience with a civil contractor"
"Hands-on experience with ITPs, lot conformance and quality records on roads, drainage or earthworks projects" (Marc has no such hands-on experience)
mandatory_unresolved: "Current Queensland driver licence": Marc holds an Australian licence, its state is not on record and he lives in Melton VIC
"Applicants must have unrestricted rights to work in Australia": Marc's Subclass 485 gives full working rights but only to December 2027
title: Project Engineer
